parsed.summary: After tracing the power chain (XT60 -> 10 mΩ shunt/INA219 -> MIC26903 buck -> LD39200 3V3 LDO), the FCC/NAVC MCU sections, the I2C/SPI/UART/GPIO interconnects, and the peripheral sheets, every component matches the spec's part list and the documented properties (barometer RESET/EOC swap, GPS MAX-8Q label, TMP100 0x4E note, PCA9685 strapped to 0x41 to avoid a 0x40 clash with the INA219 on the same NET0044/NET0026 bus, stale reference-designator notes) are accounted for. The buck feedback divider (6 k8 top, 1 k3 bottom, 19 k6 as a Vout-to-GND bleed) yields 0.8*(1+6.8/1.3) ≈ 4.98 V, consistent with the intended 5 V rail, and no signal pin is found shorted to a rail or to ground, so I report no anomaly.
